whoWeAre.p1: Designs and manufactures blown-film lines, bag-making converters, and recycling systems for polymer film processors across six continents. Founded in 2008, we have grown from a single machine type to a full portfolio of 18+ machine families — every product designed in-house, fabricated in our 12,000 m² Wenzhou facility, and tested before it ships.
whoWeAre.p2: Our customers range from single-line converters running one shift a day to multi-site groups running 24/7 on four continents. The machine has to work the same way for both.

story.title: From one line to a full machinery portfolio
story.p1: Ashal Innomech started with a single-layer blown-film line and a small team of mechanical engineers who had spent the previous decade on the shop floors of Wenzhou's established machinery makers. The founding premise was simple: build fewer machine types, but build them better.
story.p2: Today we produce eighteen machine families across blown film, bag making, and recycling. Every product is designed in-house, fabricated in our 12,000 m² Wenzhou facility, and tested before it ships.

items.e: Company founded in Wenzhou. First single-layer blown-film line.
ABA three-layer co-extrusion line. First export to Southeast Asia.
Bag-making division launched with the F-PRO bottom-seal converter.
CE certification. ABC multi-layer line certified for PBAT+PLA.
CX recycling line released. Factory expanded to 12,000 m².
ABCDE-2200 enters development. Offices in Germany & Vietnam.
ABCDE-2200 ships. RGB roll-bag machine updated.

values.title: Four things we never compromise on

items.b: Every machine starts on the drawing board, not the sales brochure. We over-engineer where it matters — drive trains, die heads, frame rigidity — and simplify everything else.
We supply spare parts and provide remote process support for every machine we have ever built. A ten-year-old line deserves the same attention as a new one.
Our lines run LDPE, LLDPE, HDPE, PP, PBAT+PLA and blends. We do not design for one resin family and leave the rest as an afterthought.
Buyers are welcome on the production floor at any stage of a build. We encourage factory acceptance tests and third-party inspection.

legalPage.sub: How Wenzhou Ashal Innomech Technology Co., Ltd. collects, uses, and protects your data, and the terms that govern your use of our website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, company name, email address, phone number, and country when you submit an inquiry, request a quote, or contact our engineering team. We also automatically collect limited technical data — including IP address, browser type, and pages visited — through standard web server logs and analytics to help us improve the site.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information you provide to respond to inquiries, prepare quotations, process spare-parts requests, schedule engineering consultations, and send order or shipping updates. We do not use your data for automated decision-making, and we never sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing of Information
sections.body: We may share information with trusted logistics partners, payment processors, or freight forwarders solely to fulfill an order or inquiry you have initiated. We may also disclose information if required by law, such as to comply with customs or export documentation for international machinery shipments.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain inquiry and order records for as long as necessary to provide after-sales support, honor warranty terms, and meet our accounting and export-compliance obligations. You may request deletion of your personal data at any time, subject to any legal retention requirements.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies & Analytics
sections.body: Our website uses essential cookies to remember your language and theme preference, and analytics cookies to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable non-essential cookies through your browser settings without affecting core site functionality.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is entirely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights & Contact
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at ashal@ashalinnomech.com. If you are located in a jurisdiction with specific data-protection laws (such as GDPR), you may have additional rights under that law.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing this website or submitting an inquiry to Wenzhou Ashal Innomech Technology Co., Ltd., you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the site.

sections.heading: 2. Quotations & Pricing
sections.body: All prices, specifications, and lead times shown on this website or provided in quotations are indicative and subject to confirmation at the time of order. Final pricing depends on machine configuration, quantity, incoterms, and prevailing raw-material costs, and is confirmed in a formal, signed sales contract.

sections.heading: 3. Orders & Payment
sections.body: Orders are confirmed only upon receipt of a signed sales contract and the agreed deposit payment. Standard payment terms, delivery timelines, and installation support are detailed in each contract and may vary by machine family and destination country.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content on this website — including machine designs, diagrams, product photography, and text — is the property of Wenzhou Ashal Innomech Technology Co., Ltd. and may not be reproduced, distributed, or used commercially without prior written consent.

sections.heading: 5. Warranty
sections.body: Machines are covered under the warranty terms specified in the sales contract, typically covering manufacturing defects for a defined period from installation or shipment. Warranty does not cover damage from misuse, unauthorized modification, or normal wear of consumable parts.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, Wenzhou Ashal Innomech Technology Co., Ltd. shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our website or products, beyond the remedies expressly stated in the applicable sales contract.
